requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement contains concern-mixing (functional action + quality criterion). Decomposed into two separate artefacts per Pohl §25.2: a functional requirement for the notification action and a quality requirement for the timing constraint.

source_fragments: The system shall inform the security service
structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service after detecting damage.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from concern-mixed requirement. Timing constraint moved to separate quality requirement.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The notification process shall have a response time of within 2 s after detecting damage.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (response time) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2. Used glossary definition for 'within 2 s'.
